decisions.reason: Because this product is close to the core offer and was given its own web page over multiple years, management is likely to stay committed to it given the visible commitment and sunk development and marketing effort.

Although the public commitment appears lighter because it was only mentioned on the website, it fits the established product range and in a growing, expanding firm its weaker results could still be interpreted as temporary rather than a reason to exit.

This product received stronger public presentation on its own page and is closely related to the firm's established formwork business, which makes management more likely to justify and continue the prior investment.

This product seems to involve less visible commitment than the stand-alone page products, but as a close complement to the firm's existing systems it is still more likely to be retained than discontinued absent clear evidence of persistent failure.
